evidence_policy.statement: The state vocabulary must be justified from repository rule files and skill text already in this repo (nahw/rules/*.json, nahw/SKILL.md). External grammar prose is internal evidence only and is never pasted into the bank.

guards: The METHOD (quarantine a row whose negative direction is disabled, then decide its vocabulary from repository rules) transfers to any eval bank; the linguistic conclusions in these four rows never transfer to another occurrence and must be re-derived per address.

scope.summary: tools/run_nahw_evals.py --bank state-machine reports nine rows quarantined as state_vocab_pending. Four declare correct_state == wrong_state (in_nafiya_negating, kulla_vs_kalla, salihan_proper_vs_deed, halim_referent_human), which disables the negative direction outright. Five more are semantically malformed against their own descriptions: lamma_not_yet is the jazm-bearing 'not yet' lamma but records temporal_lamma; la_nafiya_lil_jins and ma_relative_vs_negation both use the lam-specific jazm-bearing negation_jazm as the rival for non-jazm negators; anna_how_adverbial types the interrogative ADVERB anna as interrogative_pronoun; nima_praise_verb names the affirmation particle naam as its rival but records interrogative_pronoun. Each needs a state the released state_vocab does not contain, and inventing one to make fixtures green is forbidden. This packet decides the vocabulary under released authority and re-arms the rows, or escalates the ones that are scholar judgments.
